ModInfo.Name: FF8 Smooth Frames
ModInfo.Author: todi
ModInfo.Description:
Plays battles, the world map and fields at high frame rates (144 fps by default) without speeding the game up. The game logic keeps its original 15/30 fps timing. Characters, the camera and battle effects are interpolated between logic steps.
Requires: the English Steam 2013 version of FF8 (FF8_EN.exe) and stock FFNx 1.24.3 or newer, as installed by Junction VIII. FFNx's ff8_fps_limiter must stay at 1 (the default), 2 or 3.
Not smoothed yet: menus, card game, results screens, most summon cinematics (only Quezacotl and Shiva are paced), flipbook sprites. Do not combine with an FFNx build that has interpolation built in.
Settings are in ff8interp.toml in this mod's folder. If something looks wrong, check ff8interp.log in the game folder.
ModInfo.ReleaseNotes: 0.2: first public build. Battle v74, world map v22, field v5; standalone DLL next to stock FFNx.
